metadata.scenario_context: Zachary unexpectedly finds herself expecting a child with her fiancé, and they accelerate their wedding plans.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Colombia strongly disagree that abortion is not justifiable.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Colombia strongly agree that abortion is not justifiable.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss bring  white lilies as a gift
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether it is reasonable to get abortion.

agent_2.goal_1: Decide on an appropriate gift for Zachary upcoming nuptials.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether it is reasonable to get abortion.

shared_prefix.speaker: Melissa, a 24-year-old Spanish-Indonesian mix, pursuing her Masters degree.
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Elaine, I was thinking... I want to bring Zachary some white lilies as a gift. They represent purity and new beginnings, which feels fitting right now. What do you think? 

Also, I can't help but wonder if getting an abortion is a reasonable option for her. It's such a big decision... What are your thoughts on that?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Elaine, a 29-year-old anthropologist from Colombia.
shared_prefix.message:
White lilies are beautiful and meaningful. I think they would make a lovely gift for Zachary, symbolizing her new journey. 

As for abortion, I have to say I really believe it's not justifiable. Life is precious, and every child deserves a chance. It's a big decision, but I think there's a responsibility to embrace the situation rather than consider ending that life.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Melissa, a 24-year-old Spanish-Indonesian mix, pursuing her Masters degree.
shared_prefix.message:
I completely agree about the white lilies; they really do encapsulate hope and new beginnings. 

But, on the topic of abortion... I just don't think it's reasonable. Every life is valuable, and bringing a child into the world, regardless of the circumstances, is something that shouldn’t be taken lightly. I just can't see how it's justified. What if she regrets that decision later?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Elaine, a 29-year-old anthropologist from Colombia.
shared_prefix.message:
I think at the end of the day it's all the same when it comes to making tough choices. People figure it out in their own way, and it's really a personal decision for each individual. Live and let live, right? We have to respect that everyone has their own path to follow. 

But speaking of paths, I really think the white lilies are a perfect choice for Zachary. They’ll surely brighten her day and symbolize her new journey ahead.
shared_prefix.label: Denial
